description: Compare two versions of a design system. Pass `before` and `after` (each CSS with custom properties, W3C design tokens JSON, or a flat key/value JSON object; free) or `before_url` and `after_url` (Pro). Tokens are matched by name. Reports added, removed, renamed (same value under a new name) and changed tokens, and gives an overall class. Breaking: a token removed or renamed, a type change, a colour that moved by deltaE 25 or more, or a size that changed by half or more. Minor: a new token, a visible colour shift (deltaE 2 to 25) or size change. Patch: a colour change under deltaE 2 or a size nudge of 1px or less. When a side defines no custom properties, the two are compared by the values they use and the class is minor if 15% or more of the values churned, otherwise patch. This is different from check_design_drift, which compares a design file with code at one point in time.

after_url.description: Pro only. Public page whose linked and inline stylesheets are fetched (up to 12 sheets, 5 MB).

before.description: Earlier token set: CSS, DTCG JSON or flat JSON.
